tool.title: GitHub Pages (gh-pages)
tool.description: Push a rendered Knowledge Graph to GitHub Pages at a publication root URL — a staging preview (`branches/<slug>/`) or the release root, the same steps either way — and report the push: a status (pushed, not pushed, could not determine) and one message carrying the commit merged onto `gh-pages` and the QA result. Its steps are bootstrap-tools' `render-kg-to-github-pages` process, which first provisions the target: an orphan `gh-pages` branch, then Pages switched on to serve it.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The layer root whose Knowledge Graph is rendered, or a tree a caller already rendered and verified.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: The publication root URL. Default: the declaration's `iriBase`, else `https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/`.

inputs.name: subgraph
inputs.description: A declared directory id to render; repeatable. Absent: the whole graph.

inputs.name: sha
inputs.description: The commit that is live: the commit on `gh-pages`.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: `pushed`, `not-pushed` or `could-not-determine` — never `pushed` over a check that could not look.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: One line: the live commit, the root URL, and the QA of both what was staged and what is served.

selection.when: The CDN target is GitHub Pages: this repository's docs site and its review previews, and every layer whose declaration names a GitHub `repository`.
selection.limits: GitHub only. Pages cannot serve server-side redirects or custom headers, and a full-replace push to the `gh-pages` branch deletes what the build did not produce unless the caller restores it first (`docs-site-publish`). Another CDN is another Tool satisfying `render-kg-to-cdn`.
selection.cost: Free for a public repository: Pages and the Actions minutes its workflow uses. A deploy takes a minute or two to be served.

remedies.none: Publishing IS a push to the gh-pages branch; there is no offline arm. To look at a page, build it locally with `bun run cat preview:site`.

$comment.comment:
Its own subprocess (ruling 6, 2026-09-30), drawn in bootstrap-tools'
declared `processes/` — a layer this one needs, so the arrow points down.

── `gh-pages`: ONE way of performing `render-kg-to-cdn`.

Owner, 2026-09-30: "make sure that gh-pages is one specific tool of
general 'publish to CDN' as part of publication/staging process", and
"tools can describe their own specific subprocesses if needed to not
bog down general skills". So the general process names no GitHub step;
this node carries the GitHub half, and its steps are a diagram in
bootstrap-tools (below this harness, so the arrow points down).

`manual`, honestly: the mechanism is that subprocess — stage with
`site.ts`, deploy with the Pages workflow (or, for this repository's own
site, `docs-site.yml` / `feature-staging.yml` pushing to the `gh-pages`
branch), then report with bootstrap-tools' `pages-status.ts`. There is
no single command that is all of it, and declaring one would assert
machinery that is not there.
